main_text.p: Ajunt citra impietatem asseri[?] posse, nubes partim calore proprio & innato, partim calore solis & astrorum ad se attrahentium, partim motu aeris, & lucta materiarum contrariarum inter sese in media regione aeris detineri, donec in Elementum grauius resoluantur, & mole sua depressa in terram decidant.
Colores nubium fiunt diversi, ex diversitate materiae vaporosae, & luminis solaris, & radiorum coelestium incidentia. Color in nubibus est vel simplex, vel mixtus.Nubium Colores, §
Albus color fit, quando in nubem tenuem & raram fit luminis immissio.Albus,
Niger color fit, quando in nube crassa & densa radiorum incidentium fit reflexio.Niger,
Mixtus color in nubibus apparens est ruber, aut viridis.Mixtus,
Ruber color fit, quando in nubem humidam & fumosam terrestri adusto co-temperatam, radii immittuntur.Ruber,
Hinc causa rubedinis matutina & pluviarum, quae eam consequi solent. Nubes ita deposita, & Sole illustrata, ruborem oculis exhibet: atque etiam cum crassa & humida sit, faci-Rubedo matutina.

page.notes: Printed hyphen-break at line end: "faci-" continues as "facilime" with catchword "lime,". Doubtful readings: "asseri" (the first letters may be "afferi"), "deposita" (the last letter is uncertain). The margin note with the § sign is copied as seen. Italic words are as printed, including "Simplex" and the color words. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
